stage0086_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I... I came down to Altair, and then...」

stage0086_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「No...!
　I can't remember what came after!」

stage0086_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You need not worry about a thing.」

stage0086_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This is inside my own heart...
　Yes... you've fallen under my spell.」

stage0086_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I've been waiting for this moment...」

stage0086_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Ah... what a marvel, a body of flesh and blood...!」

stage0086_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（This isn't right...! That's not my voice!
　Don't tell me... my body...!）

stage0086_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You are a wonderful vessel of flesh...
　Now, at last, I can fulfill my long dream...!」

stage0086_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I promised, didn't I?
　That I'd fill the gap in your heart.」

stage0086_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now, you need not suffer any longer.」

stage0086_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I am $$ミカゲ$$... one who dwells in the shadow of love...
　You should be thankful.」

stage0086_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's not often a wingless one comes to house the Wings...
　Fufufufufu...! Ahahahahaha!」

stage0086_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カグラ$$
「So, you answered my call, huh.
　Just as I thought, you're my damn woman.」

stage0086_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$カグラ$$
「What are you talking about, $$シルフィ$$?」

stage0086_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$ゼシカ$$!
　Why are you here!?」

stage0086_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I figured it out!
　A way to end this war and save Altair and Vega!」

stage0086_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「To put an end to it all...!
　For that, I need the Wings of the sun...
　the power of $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$!」

stage0086_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「You carry Apollo's soul. I know you can do it!」

stage0086_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「If that's what will save everyone...」

stage0086_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Leave it to me, damn woman!
　I'll make it happen!」

stage0086_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「This works out great!
　No idea why, but since we're face to
　face like this, there's only one thing to do...!」

stage0086_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$シルフィ$$'s here too? All the better!
　Listen up, $$アマタ$$!!」

stage0086_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I'm gonna kill $$シルフィ$$!
　We'll kill each other in the name of love!
　Screw the parent who merely gave me birth!」

stage0086_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I won't accept something like that!」

stage0086_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You're weak...!
　And your love is weak too...!」

stage0086_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That's why, 12,000 years ago,
　we were torn apart from $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0086_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$カグラ$$
「And now, 12,000 years later in this life,
　you watched your mother go, too...」

stage0086_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$カグラ$$
「And this time, $$シルフィ$$ too...!」

stage0086_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$アマタ$$
「The first time I met $$ミコノ$$,
　I felt fate too!
　Someone who'd accept me and share the same pain...!」

stage0086_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But that's not all!
　$$ミコノ$$ gets sulky so easily...!
　She's quick to anger, and jealous for no reason...!」

stage0086_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Don't you daaare praise that damn woman!!」

stage0086_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But $$ミコノ$$ always gives it her all,
　and she can stand by people's pain!
　She can bring everyone's feelings together!」

stage0086_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「It's that $$ミコノ$$...
　not $$シルフィ$$, but the $$ミコノ$$ right now, that I...!」

stage0086_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「This is... $$ミカゲ$$'s maze of the heart...」

stage0086_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You're saying this is inside $$ミカゲ$$'s heart...!?」

stage0086_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「If I die, $$ミカゲ$$ won't be
　able to wield the Wings of the sun anymore...」

stage0086_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'm stupid, so...
　I can't think of any other way to stop $$ミカゲ$$.」

stage0086_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「If $$ミコノ$$ is lost, $$アマタ$$ will grieve...
　I don't want $$アマタ$$ to be sad...」

stage0086_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You... it'd be a waste to kill you over $$アマタ$$.」

stage0086_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Let's go, Wreck!
　You and I both owe $$ミカゲ$$ plenty!」

stage0086_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$カグラ$$
「This ain't the place to be hung up
　on someone like $$アマタ$$!!」

stage0086_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Yeah!
　What I really need to do is fight!」

stage0086_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Why...!
　Why was I defeated, and rejected by the Wings of the sun!?」

stage0086_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Damn you...!
　I won't let this go unanswered!」

stage0086_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$不動$$
「From 24,000 years ago...
　no, since 120,000,000 years ago, your hatred endures...」

stage0086_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Shut up! Shut up, shut up, shut up!!
　I won't forgive it!
　Not you, not the wing dog... nor them, either!!」

stage0086_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「My hatred will only grow fiercer!
　Even if the 120,000,000-year ring of fate closes!!」

stage0086_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$不動$$
「That hatred... is bottomless, is it...」

stage0086_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Heh... feels strange,
　meeting face to face like this.」

stage0086_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Will you lend us your strength?」

stage0086_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$アルト$$
「This guy...!
　Still saying that, even now...!」

stage0086_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$宗介$$
「Wait, $$アルト$$.
　I'll deal with him.」

stage0086_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$n
「I'm used to handling wild beasts.
　Everyone else, stand back.」

stage0086_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$甲児$$
「Not a chance.
　I'll be the one to pay him back first.」

stage0086_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$ミコノ$$'s put up with plenty from this guy.
　Leave this one to me.」

stage0086_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Interesting!
　I'll take you all on at once!」

stage0086_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Cut it out, already!
　Honestly, boys always resort to force.」

stage0086_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Let's do this properly, $$カグラ$$.
　We're going to be comrades fighting together from now on.」

stage0086_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I never said I'd become your comrade...」

stage0086_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$カグラ$$
「...But if Altair gets swallowed
　by a black hole, that's a problem for me too.」

stage0086_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Gloomy a place as it is,
　it's the planet I grew up on.」

stage0086_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Got it, $$カグラ$$.
　Let's fight for both worlds, Altair and Vega.」

stage0086_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Heh... don't go dragging me down, $$アマタ$$.」

stage0086_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'm going to have to teach you
　some manners, thoroughly.」

stage0086_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「More inverted talk?
　Then I guess I get to go all out.」

stage0086_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Leave it to me, $$シルフィ$$.」

stage0086_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That's not it, is it, $$カグラ$$?」

stage0086_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Yeah.
　...Looking forward to working with you, $$ミコノ$$.」

stage0086_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$アルト$$
「Well, looks like things between $$アマタ$$,
　that guy, and $$ミコノ$$ are settled.」

stage0086_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$n
「I don't know exactly why, but I get
　how you feel... It's just timing now.」

stage0086_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$n
「They're not like that $$ミカゲ$$ guy.
　Too much consideration will only
　hurt them instead.」

stage0086_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$アルト$$
「...Never thought I'd get advice
　from you on this sort of thing.」

stage0086_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$n
「...That wasn't like me.
　Forget I said it.」

stage0086_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$アルト$$
「Don't worry about it.
　Once things settle down, tell me
　about Nurse.」

stage0086_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$モロイ$$
「A few times during the fight, I felt
　Supreme Commander $$不動$$'s presence...」

stage0086_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Then it really wasn't...
　just my imagination after all!」

stage0086_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Everyone... felt Supreme
　Commander $$不動$$, huh.」

stage0086_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$桂$$
「No need to worry.
　It's him we're talking about...
　He's surely doing his own thing somewhere.」

stage0086_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「You say that like you know
　the Supreme Commander well.」

stage0086_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Could it be, $$桂$$...
　Do you know the Supreme Commander's
　past life?」

stage0086_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$桂$$
（Too much of a spitting image
　to just call it a past life, though.）

stage0086_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Forget the Supreme Commander,
　it's the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ that matters now.」

stage0086_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$甲児$$
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ was avoiding
　a clash with Mycenae. Now that they've
　fallen, he's coming at us head-on.」

stage0086_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I know that without being told.
　Anyone who messes with Altair and Vega,
　we'll crush them.」

stage0086_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Mom, Dad...
　We'll carry on the feelings you entrusted to us and keep fighting.
　We'll definitely protect both worlds.）

stage0086_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Together with the one I love.）

stage0086_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Let's go, $$ミコノ$$.
　For our future.」

stage0086_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That your Big Bang
　came back!」

stage0086_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Heh... quite the bloodbath,
　those two.」

stage0086_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I can't quite tell if that's
　inverted talk or if he means it...!」

stage0086_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now, Master $$ゼシカ$$.
　Isn't it wonderful Master $$ＭＩＸ$$
　is back to normal?」

stage0086_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Personally, I'm very glad Master
　$$ゼシカ$$ is back to normal too, though.」

stage0086_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$アンディ$$ and Master $$ＭＩＸ$$, Master
　$$ゼシカ$$ and Master $$カグラ$$... Your two pairs'
　synced attacks produced 100Z worth of Z-Chips.」

stage0086_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add this to the squad's stock.」

stage0086_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Right, $$ＭＩＸ$$?
　Even $$ＡＧ$$ says we're the best combo.」

stage0086_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「That doesn't excuse that tactless
　remark from before!」

stage0086_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't be so angry, Master $$ＭＩＸ$$.
　After all, you hold the key
　to the next battle.」

stage0086_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our foe, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, is a black
　hole given form. Truly a mystery
　of the universe.」

stage0086_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To counter that, we need Master
　$$ＭＩＸ$$'s Big Bang, another mystery
　of the universe...」

stage0086_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「You, of all people!
　It's been ages and this is
　sexual harassment?!」

stage0086_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$クレア$$
（$$シュレード$$...
　I'm sure your soul will be carried on
　by $$カイエン$$ and the other Elements.）

stage0086_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$クレア$$
（When we meet again someday...
　I look forward to it, 12,000 years from now.）

stage0086_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$クレア$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$.
　So you mourn for $$シュレード$$'s soul too.」

stage0086_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes.
　Master $$シュレード$$'s music is the sound of life...
　and that's something Z-Chips share, too.」

stage0086_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By the way, where is Supreme
　Commander $$不動$$?」

stage0086_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$クレア$$
「So you noticed.
　That he was there, in that place.」

stage0086_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$クレア$$
「He's exactly what his name says he is...
　I'm sure even now, as always, he's watching
　over us... over humanity.」

stage0086_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So Master $$クレア$$ will stand on the
　battlefield herself, in place of the
　Supreme Commander.」

stage0086_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$クレア$$
「I'm the new recruit in $c.
　Let's get along, $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0086_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, if you would do the usual, please.
　...Let's get fired up today!」

stage0086_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ahh... it's a fine thing,
　having a pretty girl drum up business.」

stage0086_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$クレア$$
「Fufu... a pretty girl, hm...
　But you can't judge people by appearances.」
